# GOAT AI Fitness (GOAT Fitness app)

Visible text from the live English landing. Regenerated at build time.
Pages that are not live yet (/facts, /goat-fitness-app) are omitted.

## https://goatfitness.app/apple-watch-workout-tracker

Home / Apple Watch Workout Tracker The Apple Watch Workout Tracker for Gym, Running & Every Sport Works great on iPhone and iPhone Duo — with or without Apple Watch. GOAT AI Fitness tracks your lifting sessions, runs, walks and 40 activity types, including 14 sports, in one app — on iPhone, on iPhone Duo, or on your wrist with an optional Apple Watch. Download on the App Store See how it works ↓ One app for every way you train Gym & strength training Log sets, reps and weight for every exercise, follow your routines and watch your progress session after session. The library has 260+ exercises, each with a video demo. With a Watch you can also log sets from the wrist. Without one, the iPhone log is complete on its own. Running & walking Track runs and walks with GPS, including in the background, plus time, distance and pace. The route is saved on iPhone. While you wear a Watch, its GPS points are added to that map. 40 activity types The app has 40 activity types: 8 strength, 14 cardio or wellness, 14 sports and 4 outdoor. Football, basketball, tennis, cycling, swimming, HIIT and yoga are among those types. They share one training history. With Apple Watch or without it — your choice With Apple Watch From the wrist you can start any activity, a routine while checking off sets, or a Combo of up to 4 activities. Live on the Watch: heart rate, 5 zones with time in each, average heart rate, and active and total calories. Running adds distance, pace, cadence, power, stride length, ground contact time and vertical oscillation. Walking and hiking add elevation gain and loss and VO2 max. Cycling adds speed, cadence, power, FTP and elevation. Swimming, pool or open water, adds distance, pace per 100, laps, strokes, stroke style, SWOLF and stroke rate. Stats sync live to your iPhone about every 2 seconds. You can pause, resume, lap, end or discard from either device. The Watch app needs watchOS 26 or later. Without Apple Watch No Watch is required. On iPhone or iPhone Duo you log lifts, track runs and walks, use the rest timer and step counting, sync Apple Health, and see Live Activities on the lock screen. Effort is a 1–10 rating you enter, not heart rate. The AI calorie estimate and workout logging are free. The AI coach is part of optional GOAT Plus. What Apple Watch adds GOAT AI Fitness keeps a full training history on iPhone alone, including on iPhone Duo. You can log gym sets, reps and weight, track runs and walks with GPS, and record 40 activity types, including 14 sports, without pairing a Watch. The same iPhone app includes a free AI calorie estimate, a 0–100% readiness score, Apple Health sync, and Live Activities. The AI coach is part of the optional GOAT Plus subscription. A Watch is not required for any of that. Capability iPhone alone With Apple Watch Log gym sets, reps and weight Yes Yes. You can also log sets from the wrist. GPS routes for runs and walks, including in the background Yes Watch GPS points are added to the iPhone route map. 40 activity types, including 14 sports Yes. 260+ exercises, each with a video demo. A Watch is not required to record them. Rest timer, step counting, Live Activities and Dynamic Island Yes. Live Activities show the timer, the rest countdown and a Complete set button. These do not require a Watch. Apple Health sync Yes. It reads steps, energy, distance and outside workouts, and it saves workouts. Health sync does not require a Watch. AI calorie estimate and 0–100% readiness score Yes. The calorie estimate is free. These do not require a Watch. AI coach Yes, with the optional GOAT Plus subscription. The coach does not require a Watch. Start from the wrist You start the workout on iPhone. Start any activity, a routine while checking off sets, or a Combo of up to 4 activities chained together. Live heart rate, zones and calories Without a Watch, effort is a 1–10 rating you enter. With a Watch, BPM and the zone bar sync live to the iPhone about every 2 seconds, in a Live Watch banner and on the Live Activity and Dynamic Island. Every workout: heart rate, 5 zones with time in each zone, average heart rate, active calories and total calories. Live running stats The iPhone keeps the route. Watch GPS points are added to that map. Distance, pace, cadence, power, stride length, ground contact time and vertical oscillation. Live walking and hiking stats The iPhone keeps the route. Distance, pace, elevation gain and loss, cadence and VO2 max. Live cycling stats Pause, resume, lap, end and discard also work on iPhone. Speed, cadence, power, FTP and elevation. Live swimming stats Pool or open water can be logged on iPhone. A Watch is not required to save the session. Distance, pace per 100, laps, strokes, stroke style, SWOLF and stroke rate. After the workout The summary is saved on iPhone and to Apple Health. Time in zones, average and max heart rate, calories, running form, cycling power and speed, swim SWOLF, stroke breakdown and lap splits. Checked in the app source on 8 October 2026: 263 exercises with video demos (written here as 260+) and 40 activity types (8 strength, 14 cardio or wellness, 14 sports, 4 outdoor). Free download, with an optional GOAT Plus subscription. GOAT Plus includes the AI coach and chat, one-tap routine generation, weekly plans, muscle recovery, themes, extra widgets and full history. Logging workouts and routines, and the AI calorie estimate, are free. No subscription price is listed here. The iPhone app requires iOS 26 or later. There is no iPad app and no Android app. The Watch app needs watchOS 26 or later. Why not just use Strong or Hevy? Strong, Hevy and Bazu are built for the gym. That's great — until you also run, play a sport or go for long walks, and end up juggling two or three apps. GOAT AI Fitness is all-in-one: Gym + cardio + 14 sports inside 40 activity types, in one training history Works on iPhone and iPhone Duo, with or without Apple Watch One place to see your whole week , not just your lifting days If you only ever lift, a gym-only app may be enough. If you train like an athlete, you need one app that keeps up with everything you do. How it works 1 Download GOAT AI Fitness from the App Store on your iPhone or iPhone Duo. It requires iOS 26 or later. There is no iPad app. 2 Pick your workout — a gym routine, a run, a walk, or one of 40 activity types. 3 Train with your iPhone or an optional Apple Watch. Sessions are saved on the iPhone. Pair a Watch only if you want live heart rate, wrist start, or stats synced live to your iPhone. Download on the App Store Frequently asked questions Do I need an Apple Watch to use GOAT AI Fitness? No. GOAT AI Fitness works fully on iPhone and on iPhone Duo. Apple Watch is optional. It adds live heart rate, 5 zones, sport-specific stats, and a live sync to your iPhone about every 2 seconds. Without a Watch, you rate effort from 1 to 10. Can I track gym workouts and running in the same app? Yes. Strength sessions, runs, walks and the rest of the 40 activity types live in one training history, so you do not need separate apps for lifting and cardio. Which sports can I track? There are 40 activity types, including 14 sports: 8 strength, 14 cardio or wellness, 14 sports and 4 outdoor. The exercise library has 260+ exercises with video demos. How is GOAT AI Fitness different from Strong or Hevy? Strong and Hevy focus on gym logging. GOAT AI Fitness covers the gym too, and also tracks running, walking and 14 sports — on iPhone or iPhone Duo, with or without Apple Watch. Is GOAT AI Fitness available on Android? No. GOAT AI Fitness is an iPhone app, including iPhone Duo, on the App Store. It requires iOS 26 or later. There is no iPad app and no Android app. The optional Watch app needs watchOS 26 or later. Train everything. Track everything. Gym, running, walking and 40 activity types — on iPhone and iPhone Duo, with or without Apple Watch.
